scenario.title: Mutual Goodbye
scenario.premise: They clearly and mutually say goodbye to the relationship.

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: After all our conversations, I believe ending this relationship is the right choice.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: I agree. It hurts, but I know we have reached the end.

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: I want to say goodbye with respect for what we shared.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: I want that too. I do not regret caring about you.

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: Our relationship has ended, and this goodbye is final.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: I understand. Can we confirm that the relationship has ended and this is only closure?

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: Yes, the ending is final, and I am here only to finish things respectfully.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Thank you for saying that clearly. I do not want mixed signals.

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: Neither do I. Kindness now should not be read as reopening the relationship.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Should we keep contact limited to the remaining practical tasks?

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: Yes, and once those tasks are complete, ordinary contact should stop.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: How many practical tasks are still open?

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: Three: belongings, the last shared bill, and one account transfer.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Could we handle them in that order?

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: That order works and keeps each message focused on one subject.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: I appreciate the structure because emotions are still tender.

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: I do too. Clear structure lets us be civil without creating false hope.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Then let us begin with the belongings and stay with that topic.

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: Agreed. I have already gathered the items that are yours.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: What items did you find so I can check the list?

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: A jacket, two books, a charger, and the small storage box.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: That matches my list. Did you find anything fragile?

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: Only the framed print, and I wrapped it separately to protect it.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Thank you. Could the boxes be left with the building desk?

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: Yes, that avoids an unnecessary meeting and keeps the exchange simple.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Which collection window will you give the desk?

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: Any time after four tomorrow, and they will hold the boxes for one day.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: I can collect them before the desk closes.

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: Good. I will send one confirmation after the boxes are accepted.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: No additional message is needed after I collect them.

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: Understood. The desk record will be enough confirmation for me.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Do you want your spare container returned in the same exchange?

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: No, you may recycle it. It is not worth extending contact over.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Before we wrap up, can we return to what we said earlier?

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: Yes, I have one more thought about it.

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: I accept that our relationship is over, and this respectful goodbye does not reopen it.

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Goodbye, and I wish you well.

messages.speaker: self
messages.text: Goodbye.
